summary: The candidate is mathematically strong and covers the full surgery-to-RT construction, including the principal definitions, ribbon representation category, purification theorem, Kirby color, normalization formula, and final RT invariance theorem. Most formulas agree with the Gold convention. It is not flawless because several Gold lemmas and propositions are only implicit inside broader entries, classification is occasionally weakened to definition/calculation/algorithm, external attribution is largely missing, and repeated IDs create ambiguous entry boundaries and locators.
strengths: Captures the central RT invariant with the convention-sensitive formula τ_{V,D}(M_L)=Δ^{σ(L)}D^{-σ(L)-m-1}{L}, including the expected values on S³ and S¹×S².
Accurately extracts Lickorish–Wallace surgery, Kirby calculus, the Turaev ribbon-graph functor, the ribbon structure on Rep_fd(A), and the Turaev purification theorem.
Preserves the selected ribbon Hopf convention θ_V=ρ_V(v) and tr_q(f)=Tr_V(ρ_V(uv)∘f), with the stated Drinfeld element.

Provides good coverage of supporting constructions such as framing, surgery handlebodies, braiding, duality, graphical calculus, modular categories, Kirby color, link signature, negligible modules, and modular Hopf algebras.
Page locators are generally plausible and follow the progression of the source from surgery through ribbon categories, Hopf algebras, modularity, and examples.
issues: The candidate has duplicate IDs for duality, ribbon category, categorical dimension, the ribbon-graph functor, and modular Hopf algebra; these are redundant extractions with non-unique locators rather than distinct mathematical entries.

The Gold handle-slide lemma, blow-up invariance lemma, and Kirby-presentation-independence proposition are not separately extracted. Their conclusions are compressed into the final RT theorem, weakening supporting-infrastructure coverage.

The Gold modular-data entry defining dim(i), twist eigenvalues v_i, D²=Σ_i dim(i)², and Δ=Σ_i v_i^{-1}dim(i)² is missing as a properly delimited entry; the candidate uses D and Δ in normalization without extracting their complete definitions.
The Gold standalone definitions of Hopf algebra, twist, finite simple system/domination, Hopf-link matrix, purification, and negligible morphism are absent or only embedded in broader entries.

Several result-like statements are misclassified: the tensor-product action and R-matrix braiding are definitions rather than Gold lemmas, categorical/quantum trace equality is a calculation rather than a lemma, and purification is typed as an algorithm.

External attribution is not recorded for Lickorish–Wallace, Kirby calculus, the ribbon-graph functor, or the main purification occurrence, even though the Gold marks them as cited classical results. Only later duplicate or example entries carry external metadata.
The dual-module entry introduces an S^{-1}-based alternative without clearly distinguishing left versus right dual conventions; the fixed Gold convention uses (a·f)(v)=f(S(a)v).

The Rohlin cobordism entry is extra relative to the Gold set and is not marked external; its added claim that W may be chosen specifically as a 2-handlebody is not properly delimited from the surgery theorem.
The final RT theorem mentions a selected rank as D_∘ while the formula uses D, producing a minor notation inconsistency.

entryLevelComparison.notes: Main formula and orientation-preserving homeomorphism invariance are accurately represented.
No single entry defines dim(i), v_i, D, and Δ together, although later entries use these quantities.
Handle-slide invariance is asserted only as part of broad Kirby-move invariance.
The normalization is present, but the separate ±1-framed unknot lemma is not extracted.
Correct proposition with R-matrix braiding and θ_V=ρ_V(v).
The formula is correct, but equality with categorical trace is classified as a calculation rather than a lemma.
Mathematical content is accurate, but the theorem is extracted twice and external attribution appears only on the later duplicate.
Statement and page are accurate, but the classical external source is not marked.
